bio_en: Hakob Khozikian, called Haji, was born in 1865 in Otur village in the Divrik district of Sebastia. In 1896 he was an ARF member in Constantinople and took part in the party meetings that decided in August 1896 to seize the Ottoman Bank to force the Powers to press Sultan Abdul Hamid for Armenian reforms. He was one of the fighters who carried out the seizure. He later emigrated to America, and when he died on 2 October 1951 in Troy-Watervliet (New York) he was described as the last survivor of the Ottoman Bank fighters.
